title: Agent Chaining order-status A2A request
description: POST to {native A2A endpoint}/message:send with header A2A-Version: 1.0. This is the native A2A REST/protobuf-JSON shape (SendMessageRequest), not a JSON-RPC envelope — there is no jsonrpc/id/method wrapper.

metadata.description: google.protobuf.Struct — arbitrary string keys. Carries the RFC 8693 delegated bearer here rather than in a header, since a custom header added by the gateway extension was observed not to survive the hop to the native A2A endpoint.
